title: Google Patents Intelligence Input
description: Search Google Patents at scale. Pass queries, patent numbers, assignee names, or inventor names. Filter by jurisdiction, year, status, and CPC class. Each patent ships as one row with optional claims, citations, and family members.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Free text Google Patents queries. Supports operators: "exact phrase", inventor:Smith, assignee:Apple, CPC=H04L. Example: ["battery thermal management", "assignee:Tesla cathode"].
queries.sectionDescription: Provide at least one of: queries, patentIds, assignees, or inventors.

patentIds.title: Patent numbers
patentIds.description: Direct patent publication numbers. Example: US10000000B2, EP3000000A1, WO2022123456A1. The actor normalizes formatting.

assignees.title: Assignees (companies)
assignees.description: Company names to search as assignees. Example: ["Apple Inc", "Tesla", "Samsung Electronics"]. Returns every patent assigned to that company.

inventors.title: Inventors
inventors.description: Inventor names to search. Example: ["John Smith", "Elon Musk"]. Returns every patent listing the named inventor.

yearFrom.title: Filing date from year
yearFrom.description: Lower bound on filing year. 0 means no lower bound.

yearTo.title: Filing date to year
yearTo.description: Upper bound on filing year. 0 means no upper bound.

jurisdictions.title: Jurisdictions
jurisdictions.description: Patent offices to include. Empty means all.

cpcClasses.title: CPC classifications
cpcClasses.description: Filter to specific Cooperative Patent Classification codes. Example: ["H04L", "G06N3/08"]. Empty means no filter.

language.title: Language
language.description: Patent text language for search and display.

fetchClaims.title: Fetch full claims
fetchClaims.description: Pull the full claims text per patent. Adds claims (string) to the row. Adds one extra request per patent.
fetchClaims.sectionDescription: Each enrichment toggle adds requests per patent. Use with maxPatents to bound cost.

fetchDescription.title: Fetch full description
fetchDescription.description: Pull the full description text per patent. This is the long body and can run to tens of thousands of characters.

fetchCitations.title: Fetch citations
fetchCitations.description: For each patent, pull the cited patent list and non-patent literature (NPL). Adds citedPatents[] and citedNonPatentLiterature[] to the row.

fetchCitedBy.title: Fetch citing patents
fetchCitedBy.description: For each patent, pull the list of later patents that cite this one. Adds citingPatents[] to the row.

fetchFamily.title: Fetch family members
fetchFamily.description: Pull the patent family list (equivalents in other jurisdictions). Adds family[] to the row with publication numbers and filing offices.

fetchPdf.title: Include PDF URL
fetchPdf.description: Resolve the direct PDF URL hosted on patentimages.storage.googleapis.com per patent.

maxPatents.title: Total maximum patents
maxPatents.description: Hard cap on patent rows pushed per run. 0 means unlimited.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Pages of 10 results to walk per query. Google Patents caps at 100 pages.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip patent numbers already pushed in previous runs. Keyed on publication number. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

navigationDelayMs.title: Delay between navigations (ms)
navigationDelayMs.description: Pause between page loads. Google Patents throttles fast scraping. 3000 to 6000 ms is the safe range.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel browser pages. Keep at 1 to 2 unless you have a residential proxy pool.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Google Patents accepts datacenter for low volume. Switch to residential past a few hundred requests.
